title: I Type Holes in Keyboard Covers – This One Survived
originalTitle: I Type Holes in Keyboard Covers – This One Survived
content:
How do you tell people that you’re a writer without using those exact words? I ask for a friend.

If you say you’re published they ask something daft: “What, like Harry Potter?” True story.

How about: I subsist on a steady diet of tea and disappointment.

That might work, it’s true at least, but I’m also from Yorkshire so who could tell the difference?

How about: I type holes in keyboard covers. That’s not a metaphor. Actual holes.

Looks like we have a winner.

You wouldn’t believe the unforgivable things that I’ve done to keyboard covers. Or how much my ability to write depends upon them.

Keyboard covers aren’t sexy but they are essential. Here’s my hot take on why you need one and my recommendation of which you should get.

An honest review of KB Covers’ DVORAK RealKey keyboard cover for the M4 MacBook Air

Writing for me means untold hours of typing whilst drinking tea and swearing at my laptop.
